crossRefs.note: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people…
“For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are…
You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifies the gold?
When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, and on the families that don’t call on your name; for they have…
The ten horns which you saw, and the beast, these will hate the prostitute, will make her desolate, will strip her…

translations.web: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?
translations.bsb: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon God.
translations.kjv: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.
translations.asv: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, Who eat up my people as they eat bread, And call not upon God?
